developer.description: Connect your Rhythmeta account to your own apps. Once an app is approved by an administrator you can use the OAuth 2.0 / OIDC login and cloud backup APIs.

developer.fieldRedirectUrisHint: 1-5 absolute URIs, fragments are not allowed.
developer.redirectRequired: Add at least one redirect URI.
developer.redirectTooLong: A redirect URI must be at most 512 characters.
developer.redirectFragment: Redirect URIs cannot contain a # fragment.
developer.redirectUserinfo: Redirect URIs cannot contain a username or password.
developer.redirectInvalid: A redirect URI must be an absolute URI such as scheme://…
developer.redirectBlockedScheme: Redirect URIs cannot use unsafe schemes such as javascript:, vbscript:, data:, blob: or file:.
developer.fieldScopesHint: Select at least one. Selecting a write scope also grants the matching read scope.
